thread.title: Amazon's market cap on track to pass Microsoft for first time - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Amazon's market cap on track to pass Microsoft for first time - MarketWatch
text: Amazon.com Inc.'s stock AMZN, +0.85% surged 0.8% in midday trade Wednesday, to lift its market value above Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -0.08% for the first time, according to data provided by WSJ Market Data Group. With a market capitalization of $704.38 billion, Amazon is now the third move valuable U.S. company, just above 4th-place Microsoft at $701.91 billion. Next up for Amazon is Google parent Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -1.18% which is second with a $746.90 billion market cap. If Alphabet's stock remained unchanged, it would take a further 6.0% rally in Amazon's stock to catch it, according to FactSet data. Amazon is still far from 1st-place Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.93% which is valued at $819.71 billion.
